parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet that houses the internal valves and connects the spout and switch.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the faucet structure and channels water from the supply lines to the spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support for other parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved tube through which water exits the faucet, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of water from the faucet to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally in some designs to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
